integrity: Proof uses analytical rotational averaging, a closed determinant and exact one-variable algebra; the executable verifies symbolic finite configurations without claiming to certify all designs. Historical priority remains provisional and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Local Fisher-information design conditional on a correct single Mogi point-source forward model, one freely chosen common station radius, equal independent three-component Gaussian errors, and a nominal depth and source center. It does not solve unconstrained station placement, misspecified elastic physics, or field validation.
title: Exact circular design for four-parameter Mogi-source monitoring
